title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle & Records Management
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Microsoft Purview implementation).

Microsoft Purview portal / Security & Compliance PowerShell / Graph authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; Purview features are heavily licensing-/plan-dependent (E5 / E5 Compliance; some preview) and the portal is evolving — availability + paths cited or flagged 'verify your licensing/tenant', never invented. Regulatory/records/legal determinations (retention schedules, file plans, legal holds, insider-risk case actions) deferred to compliance/records/privacy/legal — solutions give the technical method + evidence, not the determination; policies piloted in simulation/test before enforcement. Automation is PowerShell (S&C PowerShell / Graph); no secrets in code. No client names.
hook: Retain and dispose data across M365 on a defensible schedule
problem: Keeping everything forever is a liability; deleting too early is a breach. This solution implements data lifecycle and records management org-wide in Purview: retention policies (vs labels) across Exchange/SharePoint/OneDrive/Teams, records management (declare, the file plan, regulatory records, event-based retention), disposition review, and defensible disposal — mapped to your retention schedule — so data is kept and disposed on policy across the tenant. (Org-wide DLM/records; the SharePoint-scoped records product covers SPO specifics.)
whats_inside: Solution Overview — retention policies vs retention labels, records management (declaration, file plan, regulatory/event-based), disposition review, and the schedule-to-config mapping.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (compliance licensing, roles, the retention schedule from records/legal, in-scope workloads).

Implementation Guide — map the schedule to retention policies + labels, configure records management + file plan, wire disposition review, validate, and expand — pilot-first; the schedule and legal determinations come from records/legal.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Security & Compliance PowerShell / Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (retention applied, records declared, disposition running) plus Best Practices for defensible lifecycle management across M365.
short: Implement data lifecycle & records management org-wide — retention policies, records management + file plan, disposition review, and defensible disposal mapped to your schedule — so data is kept and disposed on policy across M365. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
